knowledge_point.title: Using Column Operations to Create a Row of Zeros in a 4x4 Matrix

question.:question/problem:
$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 4 & -6 & 8 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ -1 & 2 & 1 & 0\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 5 & -5 \\ 3 & -5 & 9 & -10 \\ -1 & 4 & -2 & 4\end{bmatrix}
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations

- $C_{2}:=\ldots$
- $C_{3}:=\ldots$
- $C_{4}:=C_{4}-4C_{1}$

each of the form $C_i:=C_i+kC_{1},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary column operations?
